questions.question: Calculate the average height for all superhero.
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(fld017) AS REAL) / COUNT(fld001) FROM tab07
questions.SQL_original: SELECT CAST(SUM(height_cm) AS REAL) / COUNT(id) FROM superhero

questions.question: What are the names of the superheroes with the power of death touch?
questions.evidence: name of superheroes refers to refers to fld008; the power of death touch refers to fld022 = 'Death Touch'
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.fld008 FROM tab07 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab10 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld019 INNER JOIN tab09 AS T3 ON T2.fld023 = T3.fld001 WHERE T3.fld022 = 'Death Touch'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id WHERE T3.power_name = 'Death Touch'

questions.question: Provide the eye colour of the superhero who has Karen Beecher-Duncan as their full name.
questions.evidence: eye colour refers to fld004.fld004 where fld011 = fld004.fld001; Karen Beecher-Duncan is the full name of superhero;
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.fld004 FROM tab07 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld011 = T2.fld001 WHERE T1.fld009 = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T2.colour FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id WHERE T1.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan'

questions.question: How many gold-eyed superheroes did Marvel Comics publish?
questions.evidence: gold-eyed refers to fld004 = 'Gold' where fld011 = fld004.fld001; superheroes that Marvel Comics published refers to fld006 = 'Marvel Comics'
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(T1.fld001) FROM tab07 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab05 AS T2 ON T1.fld015 = T2.fld001 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T3 ON T1.fld011 = T3.fld001 WHERE T2.fld006 = 'Marvel Comics' AND T3.fld004 = 'Gold'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id INNER JOIN colour AS T3 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T3.id WHERE T2.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND T3.colour = 'Gold'

questions.question: Describe the names of neutral alignment superheroes.
questions.evidence: names of superheroes refers to fld008; neutral alignment refers to fld002 = 'Neutral';
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.fld008 FROM tab07 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab01 AS T2 ON T1.fld016 = T2.fld001 WHERE T2.fld002 = 'Neutral'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN alignment AS T2 ON T1.alignment_id = T2.id WHERE T2.alignment = 'Neutral'

questions.question: Which superheroes have blue eyes with brown hair?
questions.evidence: which superheroes refers to fld008; blue eyes refers to color = 'Blue' and color.fld001 = fld011; brown hair refers to color = 'Brown' and color.fld001 = fld012;
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.fld008 FROM tab07 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld011 = T2.fld001 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T3 ON T1.fld012 = T3.fld001 WHERE T2.fld004 = 'Blue' AND T3.fld004 = 'Brown'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id INNER JOIN colour AS T3 ON T1.hair_colour_id = T3.id WHERE T2.colour = 'Blue' AND T3.colour = 'Brown'

questions.question: Rank heroes published by Marvel Comics by their height in descending order.
questions.evidence: name refers to fld008; the tallest hero refers to MAX(fld017); published by Marvel Comics refers to fld006 = 'Marvel Comics'
questions.SQL: SELECT fld008, fld017, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY fld017 DESC) AS HeightRank FROM tab07 INNER JOIN tab05 ON tab07.fld015 = tab05.fld001 WHERE tab05.fld006 = 'Marvel Comics'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT superhero_name, height_cm, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY height_cm DESC) AS HeightRank FROM superhero INNER JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'

questions.question: How many powers does Amazo hero have?
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(T1.fld023) FROM tab10 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab07 AS T2 ON T1.fld019 = T2.fld001 WHERE T2.fld008 = 'Amazo'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT COUNT(T1.power_id) FROM hero_power AS T1 INNER JOIN superhero AS T2 ON T1.hero_id = T2.id WHERE T2.superhero_name = 'Amazo'
